props.name: onCapture
props.description: Called with the still when the person presses “Use photo”.

props.name: facingMode
props.description: Which camera to ask for first. The device menu can change it afterwards.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Mirror the preview. `auto` mirrors front cameras only, as a mirror would.

props.name: quality
props.description: Encoder quality for jpeg and webp, 0 to 1.

props.name: idealWidth
props.description: Resolution to ask the camera for. The camera may deliver less.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control and the preview.
